senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גלי)exile; also (sub. בני) the exiled community, diaspora.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:11">Ab. I, 11</cite> <he>שמא תחובו חובת ג׳</he> ye may be condemned to exile.

<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:18">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ג׳ מכפרת עון</he> exile (leaving home) is an expiation. <he>ג׳ בבל</he> Babylonian captivity; <he>ג׳ יון</he> Greek (Syrian) dominion; <he>ג׳ אדום</he> Roman dominion.
Ex. R. s. 15.—Esp. banishment to the city of refuge (Num. XXXV, 11 sq.).

<cite ref="Arakhin 12a:42">Arakh. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>שלש ג׳</he> three divisions of exiles; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23:14">Num. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>סנחריב הגלה … ג׳</he> Sennacherib carried them off in three divisions.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 88a:5">Pes. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>קבוץ ג׳</he> the reunion of the exiled.
<cite ref="Menachot 110a:3">Men. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ של שאר וכ׳</he> the exiled of other countries (besides Babylonia).

<cite ref="Beitzah 4b:6">Bets. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>שני ימים טובים של ג׳</he> the two Holy Days (in the place of the one Biblical) observed by those living abroad (whom the communications of the Palestinean authorities could not reach); a. fr.
